    have h_nonempty : (Finset.range (n + 1)).Nonempty := by
      apply Finset.nonempty_of_mem
      simp [Finset.mem_range]
      omega
    
    -- Apply AM-GM
    have h_AMGM : (∏ x in Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ)) ^ (1 / (n + 1 : ℝ)) ≤ 
                  (∑ x in Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ)) / (n + 1 : ℝ) := by

        rw [← Real.rpow_mul (by linarith) (by positivity)]
